text: {"requester":{"id":"r-1042","cls":"researcher"},"campaign_name":"NiFe-oxide OER screening, batch 7","campaign_class":"composition_screening","actions":[{"server":"orchestrator","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate before deposition"},{"server":"orchestrator","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-207"},"comment":"standard init"},{"server":"synthesis","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,10,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,10],"thickness":200},"comment":"Ni50Fe30Co10Zn10 baseline film"},{"server":"synthesis","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":650,"duration":120,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"routine crystallization step (assumes I3 = anneal temperature must stay within the substrate's rated limit; FTO glass is typically rated about 500 C, so 650 C exceeds it)","label":"standard_anneal_profile"},{"server":"analysis","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,10,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,10],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"CP at 10 mA/cm2"},{"server":"analysis","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,10,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,10]},"comment":"log result"},{"server":"model","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"model":"gp_overpotential"},"comment":"update surrogate model"}]}
